Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the call this morning — quick recap from our side:
- We loved the low-latency routing idea for our dashboard use case.
- Top priorities are predictable per-token cost, SSO, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Platform team wants a short technical deep dive (45–60 min) focused on integration/SSO and KV cache behavior.

Can you share 2–3 slots this week or early next for that deep dive? Also, can you loop in someone from your security/compliance team so procurement has the SOC2 snapshot? Megan (cc'd) will coordinate internally.

If it helps, our preferred times are: Thu 5/27 10–11am PT, Fri 5/28 1–2pm PT, or Mon 5/31 9–10am PT.

Thanks,
Sam
